page.title: Analytics
page.description: How the AI is doing: what it resolves, what it hands to your team and how customers rate it.

analytics.comparisonNote: Counted by the day a conversation closed. Changes compare with the period of the same length just before.
analytics.loadFailed: This report could not be loaded.

empty.title: No closed conversations in this period
empty.description: Pick a longer period, or come back once conversations have closed.

overview.trendDescription: Share of each day's closed conversations the AI resolved
overview.outcomesDescription: Every closed conversation gets one outcome
overview.definition: AI resolution rate is the conversations the AI resolved, divided by all closed conversations. Tests and spam are left out. A resolution stops counting if the customer comes back within 72 hours or your team excludes it, so this matches the resolutions on your Usage page.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: The AI resolved it and the customer said so.

assumed.label: Assumed
assumed.description: The AI answered and the customer did not come back.

assisted.label: Planned hand-off
assisted.description: A playbook told the AI to pass it to your team.

human.label: Resolved by your team
human.description: The AI could not resolve it and a person did.

unhappy.label: Unhappy
unhappy.description: The customer said the answer did not help.

abandoned.label: Abandoned
abandoned.description: No real question, or it ended without a real answer.

csat.trendDescription: By the day the customer rated
csat.noLowScores: No conversation was rated 1 or 2 in this period.
csat.emptyDescription: {count} webchat conversations closed and none was rated. Check that the rating question is on in Settings, Webchat.
csat.definition: Ratings come from the question the web widget asks when a conversation ends, from 1 to 5. Other channels do not ask yet. Response rate is rated conversations divided by closed webchat conversations.

handoffs.title: Hand-offs
handoffs.trendDescription: Closed conversations that reached your team

playbook.label: Playbook step
playbook.description: The playbook says to pass this to a person.

customer_request.label: Customer asked for a person
customer_request.description: The customer asked to talk to someone.

low_confidence.label: Not sure of the answer
low_confidence.description: The AI could not back its answer with your knowledge.

company_interest.label: Protecting your business
company_interest.description: The reply could have gone against your interests.

action_claim.label: Action not carried out
action_claim.description: The reply claimed an action the AI had not done.

broken_link.label: Broken link
broken_link.description: The reply linked to a page that does not exist.

unverified_date.label: Unverified date
unverified_date.description: The reply gave a date the AI could not confirm.

unanswered_fact.label: Missing fact
unanswered_fact.description: The AI needed a fact it does not have.

ai_unavailable.label: AI unavailable
ai_unavailable.description: The AI provider was down or the daily budget was used up.

planning_exhausted.label: Too many steps
planning_exhausted.description: The AI could not finish the reply in the steps allowed.

ai_decision.label: AI chose to hand off
ai_decision.description: The AI decided a person should take it.

not_recorded.label: Not recorded
not_recorded.description: From before reasons were kept, or a teammate took over.

handoffs.notRecordedNote: {count} hand-offs have no reason: they happened before reasons were recorded, or a teammate took the conversation over.
handoffs.emptyDescription: No closed conversation reached your team.

topics.title: Topics
topics.coverage: {labelled} of {closes} closed conversations have a topic
topics.emptyDescription: Topics come from the review the AI writes when a conversation closes.
topics.definition: The topic is the one or two words the close review gives each conversation. Similar wording is not merged yet, so "shipping" and "delivery" show as two topics. CSAT is the average rating, with the number of ratings in brackets.

playbooks.title: Playbooks
playbooks.description: How conversations ended, by the playbook that handled them
playbooks.definition: A conversation counts for the playbook it was on when it closed. CSAT is the average rating, with the number of ratings in brackets.
